title: Every Level of Trader in 45 Seconds

beats.text: Every level of trader, from a thousand dollars to a billion.
Level one. A phone app. Fifty trades a day. Most people here lose.
Level two. Ten thousand. You discover leverage. Bigger wins. Faster wipeouts.
Level three. You quit your job. In one huge study, ninety-seven percent of long-time day traders lost money.
Level four. You trade a prop firm's money, and keep a cut.
Level five. A bank desk. A daily loss limit. A bonus.
Level six. Your own fund. Two percent a year, just for managing it.
Level seven. A billion. Your trades move the price.
Level eight. One bet against a currency, a billion dollars.
Level nine. You barely trade. Your favourite holding period? Forever.
Notice something? The higher the level, the fewer the trades. Watch it again and count.
